remarks: Welcome to this beautifully renovated studio apartment in the heart of Greenwich - one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities. This thoughtfully updated space offers the perfect blend of convenience, comfort, and charm. Ideally situated close to shopping, parks, and major transportation, you'll be just minutes from the train, making for an effortless commute to NYC. Inside, the unit has been completely remodeled and features a sleek, modern kitchen, stylish new flooring, and a convenient in-unit washer/dryer. A custom built-in Murphy bed maximizes living space without compromising functionality. Heat, hot water, cooking gas, and WiFi are all included in the rent - the only utility paid by the tenant is the supplemental electric baseboard heat. Greenwich residents enjoy access to town beaches, vibrant dining and shopping options, and an unbeatable quality of life. One off-street parking spot is included. Strong credit and references required.
